After I've succeeded in driving the Republic from Umbara, the Count will reward my actions, and make me his new apprentice.''<nowiki></nowiki>|Pong Krell and Rex|<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />}}
'''Pong Krell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A powerful [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a recognized war hero, he was relentless in his tactics on the battlefield, seeking success at all costs. As a combatant, he was an especially ferocious [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duelist]]; the advantage of four arms allowed him to wield two [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsabers]] at the same time. As a general, Krell found insubordination intolerable and required strict adherence to command from all of his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. During the war, Krell [[Force vision/Legends|foresaw]] how the Republic would be destroyed from [[Order of the Sith Lords|within]], thus [[Order 66/Legends|paving the way]] for the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This vision, coupled with his lust for power, ultimately led Krell to betray the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi way]]. Outwardly, he deceitfully maintained the appearance of his ties to the Jedi and Republic. In secret, Pong Krell had embraced the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]].

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], when the shadow planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] seceded from the Republic, Pong Krell was given command over the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], serving as an interim general during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] absence. Krell deliberately crafted incompetent battle strategies in order to sabotage the Republic's campaign to retake the planet. By covertly assisting the Separatists' efforts to retain Umbara, Krell hoped to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ranks as a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|disciple]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], thus securing a place for himself in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|future Empire]].

Krell's plans were ultimately thwarted by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under his own command. When his duplicity was uncovered, Krell was confronted by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] from the 501st Legion and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. Although he single-handedly slaughtered scores of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], eventually he was captured and detained. While restrained by [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]], Krell was fatally shot in the back by [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]], his most loyal soldier over his betrayal, thus ending the fallen Jedi's life.

==Biography==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|A new power is rising. I've forseen it. The Jedi are going to lose this war, and the Republic will be ripped apart from the inside.|Pong Krell|<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />}}
A [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]], Pong Krell ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were called into service by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Krell joined the war effort as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in the newly-commissioned [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="SWEKrell" /> composed mainly of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] grown and trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="EncyclopediaClones">{{SWE|groups|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> Although his record for [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] casualties was the highest of any Jedi officer, Krell established a reputation as a highly successful military strategist with many key victories credited to his name.<ref name="SWEKrell" />

But as the war progressed, Krell drew closer to the allure of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]. The tipping point for Krell came when he experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|premonition of the future]]; the Jedi all but [[Order 66/Legends|wiped out]], a Republic [[Declaration of a New Order|fallen]], and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] made to take its place as the hegemonic power throughout the known [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Krell was enthralled by what he witnessed and, having grown increasingly ambitious for greater power, secretly betrayed the Jedi and the Republic. From then on, he maintained only the facade of loyalty, only to act as a double agent in order to sabotage the Republic's war effort. Eventually, Krell planned to openly serve at the side of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], thus securing for himself a place of prominence in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] to come.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

===Battle of Umbara===
{{Quote|Time and rest are luxuries the Republic cannot afford. We are the key to this invasion. The other battalions are counting on our support. If we fail, everyone fails!|Pong Krell|<ref name="DOU">{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}</ref>}}
In the year [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], General Pong Krell was dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]],<ref name="DOU" /> a former member-world of the Republic that joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EncyclopediaUmbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> Krell was not only well aware of Umbara's strategic significance in the Clone Wars. He also knew that the decisive victory in the campaign depended primarily on his success.<ref name="SWEKrell" /> Hence, he recognized this battle as an opportunity to prove his worth to Tyranus. He intended to ensure that Umbara remained in the Separatist fold by purposely devising ineffective strategies.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

By the time he arrived on the planet, Republic forces had already begun their [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invasion of Umbara]] with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] leading the way to the planetary [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital city]]. After sustaining some casualties during the initial engagement with the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] natives, Krell arrived on the battlefield via a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and reported the Council's orders; Skywalker was to immediately disengage from the battle and return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Although Skywalker was shocked by this order, Krell stated that it was at the direct request of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. With Skywalker away, Krell was assigned as the 501st Legion's mission commander. Krell quickly acquainted himself with the unit's captain, [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], designated CT-7567.<ref name="DOU" />

Once he assumed command of the 501st Legion, General Krell immediately dismissed Skywalker's original plan for the capture of the Umbaran capital and largely used the clones' numbers to refer to them. Claiming this move was due to the strategic importance of the capital, as well as the fact that victory or defeat depended on the 501st, Krell decided that Skywalker's guerrilla warfare tactics were too slow and ultimately a waste of time. Hence, he concluded that unhindered military force would win the battle, and thus he ordered the 501st on a direct path to the capital [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="DOU" />

Before they reached their destination, however, Krell and the 501st were attacked by two flying [[Banshee (species)/Legends|banshees]]. Krell swiftly killed both creatures, employing [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jumps]] in conjunction with his double bladed lightsabers. Shortly afterward, Krell sent Rex and his troopers directly into a minefield, where they were ambushed and nearly overwhelmed by a group of Umbaran soldiers. Krell expressed his apparent frustration with the clones' inability to achieve success without his support, though he ultimately chose to save their lives by dispatching extra troopers and [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] [[AT-RT driver|drivers]] to assist them. Rex and his troops sustained heavy casualties, but managed to repel the Umbarans with the aid of Krell's reinforcements.<ref name="DOU" />

[[File:RexvsKrell-Umbara.png|thumb|right|250px|General Krell commanded the 501st on Umbara with Rex as his second-in-command.]]
Krell made no effort to conceal his disappointment in Rex for retreating from the enemy. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] criticized Krell's strategy in front of the other troopers, and was nearly executed by Krell in response. Rex defended his own case by explaining that he was loyal to his Jedi officer, but that he also had a duty to the safety of his troopers as well. Although he was taken by surprise due to the Captain's outspoken nature, Krell noted how Rex possessed a spark of tenacity, which he saw as a rare trait in a clone, but also an important quality in leadership. He even admitted to the unorthodox style in his leadership, but nevertheless defended his reputation as a strategist, pointing to his past victories as evidence of his efficiency. Shortly afterward, Krell left the clones to ponder his words as another ambush by the Umbarans took place.<ref name="DOU" />

====Taking the airbase====
{{Dialogue|Pong Krell|What is your plan?|Rex|I've dispatched two men on a stealth incursion into the airbase. They've been ordered to co-opt starfighters and use them against the tanks.|Krell|You what?! You put this entire assault on your hope that two clones can do what your entire group could not?!|Rex|Sir, the rocket launchers don't work on these tanks. It would be easier to slip by undetected while the rest of us keep the tanks occupied.|Krell|Captain, you will launch a full forward strike immediately, or you will be relieved of duty.|attr=Pong Krell and Rex|src=<ref name="General">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>}}
[[File:501stFrontLines-Umbara.png|thumb|left|250px|General Krell and the 501st Legion under heavy fire]]
Following this setback in the overall operation, Krell received a message from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during a firefight between the 501st Legion and Umbaran soldiers. Kenobi reported how the capital city had become a virtually impregnable [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] due to the supplies it received from a nearby [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]]. In order to weaken the capital's unassailable defense grid, Kenobi charged Krell and the 501st with the mission of destroying the airbase, and thus its supply lines to the capital city as well. Before cutting the link on the [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]], Kenobi reminded his fellow Jedi Master that the entire operation depended on the success of Krell and his 501st Legion.<ref name="General" />

Due to the high priority of his new assignment, Krell ordered Captain Rex to mobilize the clones for their deployment to the Umbaran airbase. Upon viewing their targeted location from a distance, Krell instructed Rex to lead a contingent of clone troopers through a gorge and destroy the airbase with brute force, in a full frontal assault. The Clone Captain suggested reconnaissance as an alternate approach, but Krell responded that the rest of the invasion force depended on the haste of a 501st victory, thus asserting how they did not have the time for a scouting operation. Rex kept his doubts to himself and loyally carried out his General's will.<ref name="General" />

By this time, General Krell's influence on the 501st created animosity not just between himself and some of the clones, but also between the clones themselves. After their failed attempt to take the capital, Rex paid more respect to Krell, and took extra care to offer alternative options as opposed to outright questioning the General's orders. Fives grew increasingly bitter and resentful of Krell to the point where Rex defended Krell's proven success on the battlefield in past engagements. He also reminded the ARC trooper that a clone's duty was to faithfully support his superior officer without question or hesitation. [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]] strongly supported Krell's strategy and even stood up for him against Fives on more than one occasion. [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], a hyperactive trigger-happy clone trooper, also favored the General's direct approach and paid little attention to the misgivings of his other comrades.<ref name="General" />

[[File:Epguide408.png|thumb|right|250px|General Pong Krell and the 501st Legion shortly after the fall of the Umbaran base]]
When the clone troopers encountered heavy resistance from the Umbaran [[Impeding Assault Tank/Legends|assault tanks]], Rex instructed Fives and Hardcase to infiltrate the airbase and commandeer their [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Rex then informed Krell of his deviation from the original plan, but the General was displeased at what he saw as an action that countermanded his orders. He commanded the Captain to proceed with the forward assault and left him with an ultimatum&mdash;either obey the order or be relieved of duty. Although Rex and his troopers were unable to overcome the Umbaran assault tanks, he ordered the clones to hold their ground as long as possible until Fives and Hardcase completed their task. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Appo/Legends|1119]] (nicknamed "Appo") offered to reinforce Captain Rex's position with the rest of the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]], but Krell ordered them to remain behind until after he gave the order, and not before.<ref name="General" />

Both plans ultimately succeeded in the end, with Rex's ingenuity ensuring that Krell's overall plan succeeded. With the support of the enemy's commandeered starfighters, piloted by Fives and Hardcase, Rex and his clone troopers were able to proceed with their forward assault on the airbase. While watching the burning airbase with satisfaction, Krell ordered Sergeant Appo and the rest of the 501st to converge on the fallen base. The General commended Rex, attributing his success to luck. Rex added that many clone troopers were killed while trying to take the airbase, to which Krell asserted how death was often the price for victory.<ref name="General" />

====Dissent within the ranks====
{{Quote|They will be court-martialed. They will be found guilty, and they will be executed. Make no mistake, for crossing me, you will pay the price.|Pong Krell, intending to execute ARC Trooper 5555 and CT-5597 for acts of high treason|<ref name="POD">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
After the fall of the airbase, Obi-Wan Kenobi made contact with Pong Krell. He informed the Besalisk Jedi Master of his failure to conquer the capital. Despite the fact that the city's supply lines were severed by the capture of its airbase, a Separatist fleet arrived to support the beleaguered Umbarans. Before a new strategy could be fully discussed, Kenobi's connection was cut off, preventing him from coordinating with Krell. Krell, who had earlier sabotaged the transmitter to make this happen, lied, claiming that the Umbarans had jammed their signal. Rex offered to have the clones work on reestablishing contact with Kenobi's forces, but Krell dismissed the idea and ordered the 501st to prepare for an all-out attack on the capital city. Although Rex doubted that the strategy could work without the cost of high casualties, he did not have an alternative solution. Furthermore, Krell pointed out how the Captain was loyal enough to obey a direct order without question. Hence, Rex prepared to mobilize the clones for another forward assault.<ref name="POD" />

However, before the 501st Legion carried out its assault on the capital, Fives suggested how they could use the Umbaran starfighters to infiltrate and destroy the [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]]. Krell rejected the plan on the grounds that they did not have any [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|trained pilots]] to fly the starfighters. Although Rex remained skeptical about a forward assault, he ultimately concurred with the General in that Fives and his men were amateur pilots. Fives took it upon himself to disregard Krell's orders by carrying out his plan anyway, and thus he recruited Hardcase and [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] to his cause. Together, they destroyed the supply ship, but at the cost of Hardcase's life. When Krell learned of Fives's insurrection, he sent Sergeant Appo to bring the dissenters, along with Captain Rex, to him immediately.<ref name="POD" />

When Rex, Fives and Jesse reported to the airbase's communications tower, Krell admitted that though their actions were bold, they were also clearly [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]]. Rex vouched for his men and tried to take the blame, but Fives intervened and insisted on bearing the full consequences of his actions alone. At this point, Krell was fed up with the ARC trooper's audacity&mdash;from disobeying a general's orders to dictating who should be punished for crimes of treason. Krell's decision was to arrest Fives and Jesse. He intended to have them both court-martialed, in which both would be found guilty of treachery&mdash;an offense punishable by death.<ref name="POD" />

====The carnage of Pong Krell====
{{Quote|It's treason then.|Pong Krell, preparing to fight his own clone troopers|<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />}}
[[File:KrellVsClones-CoK.png|thumb|left|250px|Krell ruthlessly slaying two clone troopers]]
Captain Rex made one last attempt to appeal to General Pong Krell on behalf of Fives and Jesse, both of whom had been imprisoned in the airbase's detention center. Krell confided in Rex his displeasure with clone troopers, noting examples of defective behavior in some of the clones who served him in the past. Furthermore, he pointed out that the two dissenters had to die, lest their actions established a dangerous precedent that encouraged other troopers to disregard the chain of command whenever they saw fit. Rex assured Krell of the 501st Legion's loyalty, but also confessed that some believed that the General was needlessly wasting their lives. In the end, Krell agreed to dismiss the trial of a court martial. Instead, he commuted their sentence to summary execution. Rex was genuinely shocked, but still assembled a firing squad since Krell possessed the authority to execute traitors on the spot.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

A last-minute plea from Fives ultimately caused the clone firing squad to disobey Krell as well. Dogma, on the other hand, was outraged and offended by his fellow clones' disregard for orders. Before Krell, who was furious at them for disobeying, could respond to the situation, however, he received a report that the Umbarans had captured Republic supplies. The report came from the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], whom Krell had contacted earlier about this, but, unbeknownst to them, he had lied, not only about the Umbarans capturing Republic supplies, but also that they were disguised as Clones. After temporarily suspending the execution of Fives and Jesse, Krell ordered Rex and the 501st to engage the Umbarans, but similarly lied to them that they might be disguised in [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II battle armor]]. Krell had intended to deceive both battalions into killing each other, with neither side being aware of what was happening. Rex and his men engaged what appeared to be enemy units disguised as clone troopers, until he found out that they actually were Clones of the 212th. Before dying, [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]] revealed how he thought that the 501st were Umbarans in disguise, due to a warning from Krell, making Rex and the rest realize Krell had intentionally deceived them and orchestrated this. Although he knew that his actions were nothing short of high treason, Rex convinced the 501st Legion and 212th Batallion to follow him as he returned to the airbase to arrest General Pong Krell.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

Krell calmly received Rex and his troopers in the watchtower, amused by their attempt to relieve him of command. As they took a position to surround him, the General accused them all of being traitors before repelling them back with a powerful [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force repulse]]. Krell activated both of his double-bladed lightsabers, easily deflected their ranged attacks while cutting them down at the same time. He then jumped out of the watchtower and landed on the surface of the airbase, only to be completely surrounded by the 501st. He charged the clones without hesitation, using his blades to protect himself from their blaster fire. After breaking through their lines and killing many clones in the process, Krell escaped into the jungle with Rex and the 501st in pursuit.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

[[File:Rexecutioner-CoK.png|thumb|right|250px|Pong Krell, moments before his death]]

Many of the clone troopers who pursued him were easily slain by the fallen Jedi Master. As the fight wore on, however, Krell's overconfidence got the better of him. Due to the quick thinking of [[Tup/Legends|Tup]], Krell was caught in the grip of a [[Vixus/Legends|Vixus]]. Even still, Krell furiously tried to cut himself free while simultaneously blocking more blaster shots and killing several more clones as well. Though he eventually freed himself, the clones took advantage of his momentarily dazed state and attacked him with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast, thus rendering the General unconscious.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

After being shackled and imprisoned in the airbase, Captain Rex asked why he had turned against the Republic, despite being a Jedi. Pong Krell revealed how he eventually came to reject the Jedi Order, which he regarded as a weak organization that only the naive could serve. He also explained how he foresaw the eventual death of the Galactic Republic, the fall of the Jedi Order, and the birth of a New Order in the imminent future. After some convincing from Fives, Rex agreed to execute Krell, but ultimately found himself unable to pull the trigger. Krell's life was ended by Dogma, the clone who had been his most loyal soldier, who unexpectedly shot the former Jedi General in the back due to his anger over Krell's betrayal. Afterward, Dogma was taken into custody for killing his Jedi officer.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" /> The fall of Krell during the battle demonstrated that Jedi could fall to the dark side if they fall to despair with the way the war was going.<ref name="Jedi">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Who Are the Jedi?]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|There's a reason my command is so effective, and it's because I do things by the book, and that includes protocol.|Pong Krell|<ref name="DOU" />}}
In war, Pong Krell was a relentless Jedi Master who settled for nothing less than absolute victory on the battlefield. Committed to both the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic, Krell became a successful general<ref name="SWEKrell" /> through his unorthodox&mdash;but efficient&mdash;strategies.<ref name="DOU" /> He was supremely confident in his command style, and thus he expected complete obedience to the chain-of-command from his subordinates.<ref name="SWEKrell" /><ref name="DOU" />

During the Battle of Umbara, Pong Krell displayed a low opinion of clone troopers, but he was especially antagonized by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] Rex.<ref name="DOU" /> He was extremely irritated by the captain's suggestion to let the troopers rest before completing their objective, as well as their failure to defeat Umbaran [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] without the assistance of his reinforcements. Krell was also not afraid to use the threat of deadly force to put insubordinate [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] back in their place, as ARC-5555 discovered when his outspoken criticism of the general's leadership was silenced with an order at the point of a [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber blade]].<ref name="DOU" /> Despite this, there were times in which he gave some hints of respect towards Rex, telling him his opinions were noted and telling him he had a spark of tenacity, although this could simply be interpreted as feigning respect in order to stay above suspicion.

In terms of military strategy, Krell was keenly aware of Umbara's significance to the Republic's war effort, including the fact that the chances of victory depended primarily on himself and the 501st Legion.<ref name="SWEKrell" /> Though viewed by some clones<ref name="DOU" /> as a gruff and uncompromising tactician, the fiercely focused Krell was unshakably determined to achieve the best results in battle so that the outcome would be nothing short of a Republic victory.<ref name="EncyclopediaUmbara" /><ref name="SWEKrell" /> Consequently, however, this record for success also produced a record for the highest casualties as well, which Krell rationalized as a natural consequence of war.<ref name="General" /> Although he was a highly skilled combatant, Krell did not normally get involved in the fighting unless absolutely necessary. During the Battle of Umbara, he intentionally remained away from most of the fighting in order to covertly assist the Umbarans and the Separatists.<ref name="DOU" /><ref name="General" /><ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

Far from being an incompetent general as some of the 501st initially perceived him to be due to his seemingly reckless strategies, Pong Krell revealed his true nature as a traitor when his own clone troopers attempted to arrest him. He detested the clones as "creatures" hatched in the [[Tipoca City/Legends|laboratories]] of Kamino. He also took immense pleasure in killing many clones with ease, as well as the fact that he no longer had to hide behind his Jedi facade. By this time, the tenets of the Jedi Order had become meaningless to Krell. In his eyes, the Jedi were too naive and the path to true power was through the Sith. As a result of his new beliefs, Krell reveled in the dark side of the Force.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You dare to attack a Jedi?|Pong Krell, to clone troopers of the 501st Legion|<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />}}
[[File:D-CUPS.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pong Krell's collapsible double-bladed lightsabers]]
Pong Krell was an incredibly powerful Force user and warrior. His Besalisk physiology allowed him to [[Jar'Kai/Legends|wield two]] double-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] at once with proficiency.<ref name="SWEKrell" /> These lightsabers both folded in the middle, making them easier to carry on his person.<ref name="DOU" /> He wielded his dual double-bladed lightsabers with deadly precision, spinning them like buzz saws for devastating effect and was capable of easily defending himself against the joint clone forces of the 501st Legion and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. Although he was undermined by his own overconfidence and the ingenuity of Trooper Tup, Krell easily massacred scores of clones with a combination of deadly lightsaber techniques and powerful Force skills. He was also highly skilled in unarmed combat, which he displayed while fighting clones with his bare hands. Despite his size, Krell proved himself to be an agile fighter as well.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />

[[File:PongKrellSafeLanding-CoK.png|thumb|left|250px|Despite his large size, Krell was very agile in combat]]In addition to being a deadly combatant, Krell was also skilled in use of the Force, using his arms to unleash a Force repulse on the first group of clone troopers that attempted to arrest him. He was also trained in Force Jump, which he used to escape from the airbase's watchtower.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />
Aside from [[Dun Möch/Legends|mocking]] the clone troopers, he also used this ability to confuse them by making his voice echo in every direction. He was also able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] emotions through the Force, such as Captain Rex's fear and uncertainty. In addition to these abilities, Krell possessed a powerful ability to foresee future events. This ability was paramount to his conversion to the dark side, for he prophesied the near destruction of the Jedi, the fall of the Republic, and the rise of an Empire.<ref name="Carnage of Krell" />
